package student

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const onboardingPathAdmissionTTL = 5 * time.Minute

type OnboardingPathAdmissionService struct {
	Revisions  LessonRevisionProvider
	Admissions repository.OnboardingPathAdmissionRepository
	Clock      LearningJourneyClock
	IDs        LearningJourneyIDGenerator
	Enabled    bool
}

func (s OnboardingPathAdmissionService) Reserve(ctx context.Context, studentID, key string, req domain.OnboardingPathAdmissionRequest) (domain.OnboardingPathAdmission, bool, error) {
	if !s.Enabled {
		return domain.OnboardingPathAdmission{}, false, domain.ErrFeatureDisabled
	}
	req, err := domain.NormalizeOnboardingPathAdmissionRequest(req)
	if err != nil || !validStudentUUID(strings.TrimSpace(studentID)) || !validStudentUUID(strings.TrimSpace(key)) || s.Admissions == nil || s.Clock == nil || s.IDs == nil {
		return domain.OnboardingPathAdmission{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return s.Admissions.Reserve(ctx, req, studentID, key, s.Clock.Now().UTC(), onboardingPathAdmissionTTL)
}
func (s OnboardingPathAdmissionService) Renew(ctx context.Context, studentID, admissionID, executionID, key string, fence int64) (domain.OnboardingPathAdmission, bool, error) {
	if !s.Enabled {
		return domain.OnboardingPathAdmission{}, false, domain.ErrFeatureDisabled
	}
	if !validStudentUUID(studentID) || !validStudentUUID(admissionID) || !validStudentUUID(executionID) || !validStudentUUID(key) || fence < 1 || s.Admissions == nil || s.Clock == nil {
		return domain.OnboardingPathAdmission{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return s.Admissions.Renew(ctx, studentID, admissionID, fence, executionID, key, s.Clock.Now().UTC(), onboardingPathAdmissionTTL)
}
func (s OnboardingPathAdmissionService) Materialize(ctx context.Context, studentID, admissionID, key string, v domain.OnboardingPathMaterialization) (domain.OnboardingPathMaterializationResult, bool, error) {
	if !s.Enabled {
		return domain.OnboardingPathMaterializationResult{}, false, domain.ErrFeatureDisabled
	}
	v, err := domain.NormalizeOnboardingPathMaterialization(v)
	if err != nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) || !validStudentUUID(admissionID) || !validStudentUUID(key) || s.Admissions == nil || s.Clock == nil || s.IDs == nil {
		return domain.OnboardingPathMaterializationResult{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if s.Revisions != nil {
		if reader, ok := s.Admissions.(interface {
			ReplayMaterialization(context.Context, string, string, domain.OnboardingPathMaterialization) (domain.OnboardingPathMaterializationResult, bool, error)
		}); ok {
			result, replayed, err := reader.ReplayMaterialization(ctx, studentID, key, v)
			if err != nil || replayed {
				return result, replayed, err
			}
		}
		items := make([]domain.LearningPathItem, len(v.Lessons))
		for i, l := range v.Lessons {
			items[i] = domain.LearningPathItem{ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: l.LessonID, LessonRevisionID: l.LessonRevisionID, Position: i, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, Targets: l.Targets, ReasonCode: "prerequisite_sequence"}
		}
		items, err = freezeLessonItems(ctx, s.Revisions, items, v.ExecutionID, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.OnboardingPathMaterializationResult{}, false, err
		}
		for i := range items {
			v.Lessons[i].Item = items[i]

		}
	}
	return s.Admissions.Materialize(ctx, studentID, v, admissionID, key, s.IDs.NewID(), s.Clock.Now().UTC())
}
func (s OnboardingPathAdmissionService) Abort(ctx context.Context, studentID, admissionID, key string, v domain.OnboardingPathAbort) (domain.OnboardingPathAdmission, bool, error) {
	if !s.Enabled {
		return domain.OnboardingPathAdmission{}, false, domain.ErrFeatureDisabled
	}
	v, err := domain.NormalizeOnboardingPathAbort(v)
	if err != nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) || !validStudentUUID(admissionID) || !validStudentUUID(key) || s.Admissions == nil || s.Clock == nil {
		return domain.OnboardingPathAdmission{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return s.Admissions.Abort(ctx, studentID, v, admissionID, key, s.Clock.Now().UTC())
}
func OnboardingPathRequestHash(v any) string {
	b, _ := json.Marshal(v)
	d := sha256.Sum256(b)
	return hex.EncodeToString(d[:])
}
